# Vendored highlight.js

This directory vendors the browser bundle and GitHub theme from
`@highlightjs/cdn-assets` version `11.12.0` so code blocks remain usable when
AgentSession is offline.

Source: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/@highlightjs/cdn-assets>

Upstream: <https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js>

Package tarball integrity (npm):
`sha512-KvOKXODaiFmId9xaq3xc5xCL66wVLUuOngDbO9B/kewbFTqdGbn2nJxNhN3H5R1cgDTVj6R8vH0zgiNDEGjpDw==`.

The accompanying `LICENSE.txt` is the upstream BSD 3-Clause license. Update
the package version, integrity, and license together when refreshing these
assets. The bundle is intentionally vendored rather than added as a runtime
dependency.
